State.Detect.doc: Entry for the 'where am I' detector. The DetectState custom action (sxs/state.py) runs each node in custom_action_param.order against the same frame and stops at the first hit, so put popups and overlays before the screens they cover. (A plain next-list is not used because MaaFramework batches OCR across next-list nodes, which misread several screens.)

State.Agreement.doc: Publisher's first-run User Agreement dialog. Needs a human to accept.

State.Loading.doc: The dark 'Loading...' screen, or 'Logging in...' over the title.

State.RewardPopup.doc: 'YOU RECEIVED' banner after claiming anything (cart, quests, loot). Tap anywhere to close.

State.ConfirmDialog.doc: Generic two-button Confirm dialog (Cancel left, OK right). The dialog grows with its content, so the title sits anywhere from y=330 to 450.

State.Dialogue.doc: Story or tutorial dialogue box at the bottom with the 'more' arrow. Tap the box to advance.

State.Battle.doc: Battle in progress (auto). 'Round n/15' at top centre. Checked after BattlePrep, which shows the same counter.

State.BattlePrep.doc: Encounter screen before a fight: enemies at top, 'Start Battle' button.

State.Home.doc: Home scene (cart, cherry tree). Bottom nav shows the 'Home' label under the centre house.

State.WorldOverview.doc: Island picker reached from the World tab (right end of the bottom nav).

State.WorldMap.doc: Walking map of one island: minimap top right with '(x, y)' coordinates under it. OCR sometimes reads the comma as a period ('134.93').

State.MainMenu.doc: Menu sheet from the box button on Home: event banner, Quest, Mall, Friends, Gallery, Photo, Notice, User Center, Settings, server clock. User Center moves up as rows are added, so the ROI covers the grid.

State.Quests.doc: Quest list (title top left): Guidance, Achievement, or Daily / Weekly Quest (the Menu > Quest default since 2026-11-04; tabs Daily | Weekly | Quest | Achievement).

State.Title.doc: Title screen after loading finishes: 'Tap to Play' near the bottom, side buttons (Servers, Settings, Notice...) on the right.

State.Loading.Title.doc: Title art while resources initialise: build string top left but no 'Tap to Play' yet (State.Title is checked first). Reported as 'loading'.

State.Interact.doc: Card popup for a map object (portal, statue, node...) with one action button at (360, 895). Only whitelisted verbs count, so a 'Purchase' or 'Spend' card stays unknown. Card heights vary (statue cards put Unlock at y≈1040), so the region runs to y=1080.

State.Defeated.doc: Confirm dialog after losing a fight: 'Your character is incapacitated. Return to Home now?' OK at (490, 830) goes home. Checked before State.ConfirmDialog.

State.Cart.doc: Cart (AFK income) panel from tapping the cart on home: income rows (Rolla, Wood, Stone, Raw Ore, Battle Essence; Gear unlocks at Lv 15) with upgrade arrows, 'Claim All' at (360, 1098). Close by tapping outside (360, 1220).

State.TapToContinue.doc: Full-screen result overlays that end with 'Tap to Continue' at the bottom (e.g. UNLOCKED furniture). Tap anywhere.

State.DialogueChoice.doc: Dialogue with reply options: white pill buttons with a black arrow at the left, above the speaker box. Tap the option (the bot takes the lowest one, nearest the box). Checked before State.Dialogue, which also matches.

State.DungeonFloor.doc: Between floors of a mini-dungeon: '<Name>: Floor n' card with flavour text and 'Next Floor'; the back arrow leaves.

State.TowerResult.doc: Fantasia Ascent (tower) result screen: VICTORY (top, with '<Tower> Fn' and Clear Rewards) or DEFEAT (mid-screen); Auto Challenge checkbox at (476, 1158) and Continue / Retry at (552, 1212). After a win Continue goes straight to the next floor's battle prep. A loss turns Auto Challenge off. Images: docs/screens/dailies/fantasia_victory.png, docs/screens/dailies/fantasia_defeat.png.

State.TowerList.doc: Fantasia Ascent tower list (reached by the quest's Go, which travels home first). Each tower card shows 'Current: Fn/110'; tap the card to open its floors. Image: docs/screens/dailies/fantasia_ascent.png.

State.TowerFloors.doc: One tower's floors (F1 at the bottom), tabs 'Fantasia Ascent' (detected) and 'Goals' at the bottom; the current floor shows the recommended power and a Challenge button at (610, 1096). Image: docs/screens/dailies/fantasia_floors.png.

State.QuestDetail.doc: Quest detail card (title, Details, Goal, Rewards) from tapping a quest on the tracker; button Track, Stop Tracking or Go at the bottom.

State.PlayerProfile.doc: Own player profile popup (tap your character on the map): power, rank, stats, gear, techniques, 'HP: n%' bar, Dish and Quick Heal buttons. Close by tapping outside.

State.EnhanceGear.doc: Enhance Gear: piece tabs along the top (+level badges), the selected piece's '+21 -> +22', cost, Enhance.

State.Featured.doc: Featured events list from Home's 'Thrilling Events' button: Dawnstar Prelude (draws: never), Growth Trial, Daily Sign-in, Link Account (never).

State.DailySignin.doc: Daily Sign-in calendar (30 tiles). Today's tile says Claim; 'Catch Up' tiles for missed days are skipped.

State.GrowthTrial.doc: Growth Trial: day tabs of trial quests with Claim buttons when complete. 'Advanced Trial' is paid: never.

State.Journal.doc: Journal tab (bottom bar, second icon): Fantasia Ascent, Map Exploration, Material Realms, Weekly Events.

State.MaterialRealms.doc: Material Realms: realm list (Ironvein Pit), a realm's mining screen, or its Goals tab.

State.Notice.doc: Notice board (tabs Notice / System / News). Its red badges mean unread posts, not claims.

State.PrayerResult.doc: Prayer result: the pulled skills and shards, 'Prayers Today' top left, Pray x1/x10 again at the bottom (never on the bot's own).

State.Prayer.doc: Prayer (Goddess Statue on home): Standard / Affection banners, Pray x1 / x10, tabs Prayer / Exchange / Goals. Pulls only via sxs.pray with the handler's approval.

State.GuildJoinList.doc: Join Guild list (Guild tab > Join Guild Go>>): guild rows with Join/Apply buttons, Refresh, Join/Create tabs. Social: never press Join/Apply/Create without mae. Back arrow bottom-left (74,1216).

State.GuildNoGuild.doc: Guild tab before joining a guild: Join Guild (Go>> at 510,485) and Create Guild (<<Go at 210,980) cards. Joining or creating is mae's decision.

State.Guild.doc: Any Guild tab screen: bottom bar label 'Guild' under the 4th icon (selected tab). Fallback for guild screens not mapped yet.

State.BackgroundFight.doc: A fight that can run in the background (Conquest, ...): the minimise icon at the bottom left. Tap it (72,1216) to leave the fight running and do other things (mae, 2026-11-04).

State.GuildDonation.doc: Guild Lobby > Donation popup. 'Daily Donations: N/5' above the button; the button reads Free (first) then Donate + Dawnium cost (20, then 50). mae: at most 2 a day, Dawnium approved for those two. Close by tapping above (360,60).

State.GuildConquest.doc: Gate of Expedition > Conquest: shared guild boss by floor. Top: 'Daily Challenge Attempts: N/2'. Reward chest (356,732) claims a beaten floor's reward; floor strip y 892; Challenge (360,982) -> battle prep Start Battle (360,956) -> background-fight icon. Tabs: Conquer (160,1216), Rankings, Goals (608,1216).

State.GuildPanel.doc: A guild sub-screen with a top-left title: Lobby (Guild), Territory (Overview), Upgrade (Facility Upgrade), Construction, Forge / Power Station / Mine (gather slots), Guild Events, Conquest goals. Back arrow bottom-left (74,1216). Conquest Rankings too.
State.GuildPanel.expected: ^(Guild|Overview|Facility Upgrade|Construction|Forge|Power Station|Mine|Guild Events|Rankings|Serverwide Conquest Goals|Personal Conquest Goals)( ?Level: ?\d+/\d+)?$

Guild.EmptySlot.doc: Empty gather slot (+) in a guild facility (Forge, Power Station, Mine). Not a screen state; used by sxs/guild.py.

Home.BedXP.doc: Bed XP bubble (blue orb in a yellow frame) over the bed in the home house: AFK EXP is ready to collect. Not a screen state; used by the daily bed step.

State.SkillPage.doc: Skill page (Character > Skill): techniques left, charms right, Quick Upgrade beside the lower-right charm, Loadout switcher, Technique/Charm/Shard tabs (R-080, R-104). Detected by its bottom 'Skill' tab (the profile's loadout editor, titled Edit, has none).

State.TechniqueUpgrade.doc: A technique's Upgrade (Battle Essence) or Ascension (its own shards) tab.

State.UpgradeGoals.doc: Goals tab of an upgrade screen (Skill, Quality, Enhancement, Level, Power, Total Class Level goals): free Claim buttons.

State.ClassPage.doc: Class screen (Change Class, Class Hierarchy, Goals tabs) and a class's Info/Upgrade page. Change Class is mae's decision: never tapped.

State.RankAdvancement.doc: Rank Advancement (the Apprentice badge on Character): raises the level cap; costs ore, Bellflowers and Rolla.

State.GearResonance.doc: Gear Resonance (Enhance Gear > Resonance): free stat bonuses when all 4 pieces reach +5, +10, ...; Activate claims one.

State.MapExploration.doc: Journal > Map Exploration: Resource Hunt card with stamina, 4 material choices (Rolla, ore, sand, Battle Essence) and Go (R-108).

State.RatingPopup.doc: Akane's 'do you satisfy with your experience' rating prompt (Very Satisfied / Dissatisfied / Later). mae, 2026-11-04: press Later.

State.Companions.doc: Companions list (Akane, Qin, Killian: story NPCs) with Invite buttons; the tutorial locks it before Auroradrasil with a filled glow on Akane's Invite (docs/screens/dialogs/companions_invite_tutorial.png). Inviting waits on mae (sxs/loops/tutorial.py INVITE_COMPANIONS).

State.Mall.doc: Mall (home menu > Mall): Premium Picks list of USD pages; only the free gift boxes inside are ever tapped (sxs.mall, R-121).

State.Chat.doc: Server / Guild / Private chat panel, opened by a stray tap on the chat strip of any screen (seen 2026-11-04 during a Conquest fight). Close with the down chevron bottom left (42, 1226). Image: docs/screens/system/chat.png.

State.ChooseReward.doc: 'Choose Your Reward' after clearing a Realm / mini-dungeon: two skill cards with a radio each, OK at (360, 993). mae (2026-11-05): one card marked Class Mismatch -> take the other; otherwise ask. Code: sxs/actions/choose_reward.py. Image: docs/screens/dialogs/choose_reward_skill.png.

State.AreaMap.doc: Area map (tap the minimap): the kingdom's areas with Exploration % and power, legend top right (Portal, Lost Statue, ores). Tapping a spot moves the camera there; an area label opens nothing but a stray tap can select an area (a yellow highlight). Back arrow (60, 1216) returns to the island map. Images: docs/screens/world/world_area_map.png, docs/screens/world/area_map_v3.png.
